# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

This repository is a requirement-generation workflow called Product Requirement Foundry.

Use it to turn short product requests into history-compatible PRD and OpenSpec handoff artifacts.

## Copilot Working Rules

- Read `baseline/request/` first.
- Read historical sources under `baseline/` before drafting outputs.
- Treat existing product changes as incremental unless clearly greenfield.
- Keep facts and assumptions separate.
- Preserve compatibility, fallback, rollout, rollback, and tracking implications.
